sentences.text: No; the KFS states pre-payment / foreclosure charges are Nil, while the home loan agreement states a pre-payment charge of 2% of the principal outstanding.
A copy of the home loan agreement states a different pre-payment charge of 3% of the principal outstanding, so the in-force agreement texts do not match each other either.
The earlier RBI pre-payment-charge direction required the charge's applicability to be disclosed in the sanction letter, loan agreement, and KFS, but that direction is no longer in force.
